name: ferrata-lodestar-differential
description: Lodestar's light client (TypeScript) as a second differential oracle for ferrata-core: see ../HELIOS-DIFFERENTIAL.md. The overrides pin Lodestar 1.43.0's own packages and the @chainsafe SSZ packages to the versions published before it (the newer @chainsafe/ssz refuses a list limit @lodestar/types 1.43.0 declares), and replace @lodestar/spec-test-util (a test helper @lodestar/config lists as a dependency) by an empty stand-in.
